tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-backend.md <<'EOF'
# TLS backend

The project's current recorded decision is to use rustls as the TLS backend, because it fits our Rust code better, has fewer CVEs and is simpler. Related recorded decisions: HTTPS is used everywhere with no plaintext exceptions, certificate verification is enabled in all builds, and tests use self-signed certificates.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-backend.md
tool_input.description: Create the TLS backend policy file

Those go slightly beyond "the TLS backend", so drop that sentence if you want the file to name only the backend.
